name: browser-use
description: Full-platform browser automation for Claude Code. v1.4.0 unifies live-page control and a configurable agent brain: in-page JS eval (browser_evaluate), keyboard primitives (browser_press_key/browser_keyboard), selector focus (browser_focus), and env preflight (browser_doctor) — unblocking code editors (Monaco/CodeMirror) and keyboard-driven UX, with run_script that fails fast instead of hanging; plus pick the LLM per project via .claude/settings.json or per task via browser_set_agent_model across Anthropic, OpenAI, any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Kimi/GLM/Moonshot/Zhipu), and Browser Use BU3 (defaults to claude-sonnet-5), dual local/cloud browsers (browser_start_cloud_session), a Chrome-proliferation fix (session.kill() shutdown + orphan reaper), and a Chromium channel that never hijacks your real Chrome. 26 MCP tools, 6 skills.
